Twin Villa | Fully Furnished | Vacant

Available for Rent in Flora, DAMAC Hills

Experience refined living in this beautifully furnished 3-bedroom townhouse, nestled within the prestigious Flora community at DAMAC Hills. Designed for comfort and elegance, this home offers a serene retreat with easy access to premium amenities.

Property Highlights:

Plot Size: 3,517.32 sq. ft
Bedrooms: 3 + maid’s room
Bathrooms: 5
Fully furnished with high-quality finishes
Spacious living and dining areas perfect for family gatherings
Built-in wardrobes for optimized storage
Extra family living area/Study area
Private landscaped garden ideal for relaxation and entertainment
Close to Golf entrance

Community Features:

Secure, gated community with 24/7 security
Family-friendly environment with quiet, green surroundings
Landscaped gardens and parks within walking distance
Convenient access to community amenities, schools, and main roads
Close to the Park and the Malibu 

This townhouse offers an unmatched combination of comfort, style, and location—ready for you to move in and enjoy the best of DAMAC Hills living.
